summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for PDF import fixes. Public endpoint import of supplied fixture succeeded with 250 tasks; validation failures remained correct; managed-storage 5xx retry behavior passed new unit tests. Expo web import screen loads without runtime errors, but headless automation could not complete DocumentPicker-driven upload flow end-to-end.

integration_issues.flow: Web import-plan -> Choose PDF -> transition to review
integration_issues.issue: In headless Playwright, DocumentPicker upload could not be completed to reach review state despite input[type=file] being present; no runtime error surfaced. Needs manual browser/device verification for picker event chain.

action_items: Manually validate import on physical Android Expo Go using a real Files-provider PDF to confirm staged-copy -> original-URI fallback path under actual SAF permissions.
Manually validate web DocumentPicker upload interaction in non-headless browser session to confirm review-state transition after selecting the same fixture PDF.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/import-api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback, while platform guidance states EXPO_BACKEND_URL; keep env naming consistent across app/config docs to avoid deployment drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression is stable from public URL. Remaining gap is picker-driven client upload confirmation on real Android and manual web interaction; automation covered route render and no runtime errors but not full picker completion.
rca_of_issue: Original report linked to transient storage/backend failures and Android file readability edge cases. Current backend retry logic for all 5xx and frontend fallback path are present and validated (backend by tests, frontend by code inspection).
